items.label: riddle
items.title: Found in 2 Tries ⚖️ Riddle #11 Answer + Riddle #12: The Snail in the Well 🐌 #shorts

qa.heard: Yesterday, 8 balls, one a bit heavier and only 2 tries on the scale.  First, put 3 balls on each side and keep the last 2 balls off the scale.  If the scale stays level, the heavy ball is one of those 2.  Put them on the scale, one against one.  If one side goes down, take those 3 balls and put one ball on each side.  Level again, then it is the third ball, found it, in just 2 tries.  Now, a brand new mystery.  Person 1 finds a snail at the bottom of a well 10 meters deep.  Every day, the snail climbs up 3 meters.  But every night, while it sleeps, it slides back down 2 meters.  On which day does the snail finally get out of the well?  Comment your answer, the answer drops tomorrow at sunrise.
qa.second_check_notes: Fresh-subagent review: #11 solution correct (3 v 3, 2 off; level -> 1 v 1 of the 2; else 1 v 1 of the heavy 3, level -> third); #12 snail well posed, answer (day 8) not shown; no salam, Person 1 only; back view only.

items.title: Thoda Magar Roz! Allah Ko Sab Se Pyara Amal | Sahih Muslim 783 #shorts

qa.heard: روز ایک گھنٹا یا روز صرف دو منٹ اللہ کو کیا زیادہ پسند ہے  عزرت آئیشا رزی اللہ آنها بیان کرتی ہیں  یہ ہمارے نبی محمد مصطفہ صل اللہ تعالی علیہ وعایلی ہی وصول دو  نے فرمایا اللہ کو سب سے پیارے عمل وہ ہیں جو ہمیشہ کیے جائیں چاہی تھوڑے ہوں  یعنی ایک دن بہت زیادہ پھر چھوڑ دینہ نہیں  بلکہ تھوڑا مگر روز  روز دو رکت نفل روز ایک صفہ قرآن روز ایک چھوٹا صدقہ  کمٹ میں لکھیں آپ روز کونسا ایک عمل کریں گے  یہ ویڈیو آگے بھیجے یہ بھی ایک اور صدقہ ہے

items.label: kids
items.title: Oops, I Broke a Cup! ☕ Always Tell the Truth | Islam for Kids #shorts

qa.heard: Oops, you broke a cup. Nobody was looking. What do you do?  Our Prophet Muhammad Mustafa sallallahu ta'ala alaihi wa a'ala alihi wa sallam  One said, telling the truth leads to good deeds and good deeds lead to paradise.  So you go to mama and say, I broke the cup. I am sorry.  Telling the truth can feel hard, but Allah loves people who tell the truth.  And when you keep telling the truth, people trust you more and more.  So always tell the truth even when it is hard.  Will you always tell the truth?  Say, yes I will.
